test_pybind11_warning_simple: test the pybind11 warnings module to verify Warning, RuntimeWarning, and FutureWarning are emitted correctly
test_pybind11_warning_invalid_category: test the pybind11 warnings module to verify RuntimeError is raised when an invalid warning category is used
test_pybind11_warning_duplicate_register: test the pybind11 warnings module to verify RuntimeError is raised when a duplicate warning type is registered
test_pybind11_custom_warning: test the pybind11 CustomWarning type to verify it is a subclass of DeprecationWarning and emits correctly
test_pybind11_warn_with_custom_type: test the pybind11 warn_with_custom_type function to verify it emits a CustomWarning and returns value 37
